free_tier.stated: Registered free account: max upload 20 Gb, storage 1 TB, download volume '5 GB in 1 days', files deleted '30 days after last download'.
free_tier.notes: Anonymous upload is weaker still: 1 GB/day of download volume against the registered 5 GB.

per_object_cap.notes: Quoted as 'Max upload file size' - the largest single file a client may upload.

retention.stated: Premium: 'Never'. Registered: '30 days after last download'.
retention.notes: The 30 days applies to the free registered tier; premium files are never deleted for inactivity.

egress.terms: Premium: 'Download volume 30 GB in 1 days'. Registered: 5 GB in 1 days. Anonymous: 1 GB in 1 days. Premium also adds download-accelerator support and resumable downloads.

interface_detail: Web upload with remote URL upload on premium. No API endpoint is published on the page read.
tooling: Browser only as read; the host is on the PrimeLeech generator list at generator/fileal.html. No rclone backend found.
chaining: 4 TB of storage with files kept forever is the largest archive-shaped offer, but 30 GB/day caps a month at about 900 GB, so it is an archive that cannot be emptied at speed.

limits.value: 30 GB per day of download volume on premium
100 GB per file premium, 20 GB registered

limits_note: The three columns (Anon / Premium / Registered) are printed out of order in the vendor's table; the numbers above are read from the column labels.
binding_note: The 4 TB archive can be filled but not drained.

identity_cost.detail: Premium bought at $29.95 for 30 days. The page shows no payment-method list beyond the checkout button; 'Purchase Extra Traffic' is offered as a separate item.

reliability_note: Anonymous downloads are capped at 1 GB a day, so an unregistered pull of a large file fails on volume rather than on a wait; a test file (100 Mb) is published for checking speed before paying.
confidence_note: The three-column feature table and the three prices were read on the vendor premium page. The table's columns are unlabelled in the extracted text and were mapped by order; a second read of the rendered page would confirm the mapping.

evidence.proved: the prices (30 days $29.95, 90 days $59.95, 365 days $99.95) and the feature table: Premium 100 Gb upload / 4 TB / 30 GB/day / never deleted; Registered 20 Gb / 1 TB / 5 GB/day / 30 days

price_per_tb_month: USD 29.95 per month for 4 TB stored and 30 GB/day
notes: The $99.95 year is $8.33 a month. 4 TB stored for $8.33 is the cheapest storage per euro, and the 30 GB/day drain is what makes it an archive rather than a workspace.

extras.supports_: download accelerators and resume on premium only
